brief.summary: Ana Morais asks whether she can successfully challenge the rent increase, what the objection deadline is, and what documents or information she should prepare. She contests an increase for her flat at Neugasse 8, Weinfelden, from CHF 2,050 to CHF 2,290 per month, attributed to a higher mortgage reference interest rate and stairwell renovation/new lift. She accepts that the reference rate rose, but questions whether the lift constitutes value-adding work because the old lift repeatedly broke down, and asks whether costs may have been counted twice. The file does not state the year of the 1 April effective date or the date she received the notice, so the objection deadline cannot be determined from this file. No other case files were provided.
